title: Enumeration cache snapshot (getcasefiles page)
description: Raw response from HKLII's /api/getcasefiles endpoint, saved as provenance when the scraper runs with --save-enum-responses. On disk at output/.enum_cache/{court}_{lang}/{unix_ts}_page{NNNN}.json. One file per paginated page. Not part of the primary corpus — consumers should ignore this directory unless auditing enumeration coverage.

totalfiles.description: Total judgments in this court/lang bucket at the time of enumeration. Same value repeated across every page of the same enum run.

judgments.description: Per-page listing. Each entry is a minimal record — the full metadata JSON is fetched separately per row.

cases.description: Dockets disposed of by this judgment.
